📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #102 (last_notified_at 2026-07-31T11:24:00Z, ~1d5h44m ago — exceeded the 24h suppression window).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor is one of the 5-monitor team:crm AMQP-consumer family, name matches "throughput dropped (possible stall)" or "heartbeat — consumer silent"). Re-pull sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:<name>,env:prod}.as_rate() over a multi-hour window — expect a genuine brief dip below the floor, not a data gap. Confirm 0 status:error logs. Check sibling monitors for co-firing. Do not re-investigate from scratch — log occurrence and compare shape against this entry.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_jira not set (fix_status: monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed)
